guardrails.title: Semantic runtime-env snapshot scanner
guardrails.why: defaultRuntimeEnv() must not be captured during module evaluation through IIFEs, class expressions, decorators, computed names, or constructed inline functions.

contains: eagerly constructed function expression default parameter
eagerly constructed class expression constructor parameter

guardrails.title: Composed skill trust boundary
guardrails.bugClass: trusting base prompts while injecting composed prompts
guardrails.why: The trust cache, TUI activation, tool activation, artifacts, and compaction restore must agree on the final composed prompt SHA.

guardrails.title: Release dispatch idempotency
guardrails.bugClass: stale or fast-completed workflow runs masking dispatch state
guardrails.why: Tag-release dispatch must confirm a new workflow_dispatch run by count increase, keep an adequate wait window, and avoid stale active-run or timestamp filters.

guardrails.title: Opaque Git parser state
guardrails.bugClass: clone option prefixes hiding dangerous config
guardrails.why: Network safety parsing must continue scanning clone option prefixes so later --config and --config-env smuggles are still detected.

contains: rejects git clone mixed short option prefixes before --config smuggles
rejects git clone mixed short option prefixes before --config-env smuggles

guardrails.title: Bounded output and JSON repair
guardrails.bugClass: large output or JSON races hiding state changes
guardrails.why: Large command output must be explicitly truncated, and corrupt JSON rotation must not overwrite or ignore concurrent repairs.

contains: does not rotate when the file content changed after the caller read it

guardrails.title: A2A ledger evidence parity
guardrails.why: A2A control-plane rows must preserve authoritative state, response, transcript, workGraph, and non-secret embedded metadata across Rust reload/persist and TS audit/report consumers.

contains: hydrates Rust-style embedded task evidence when top-level fields are missing

guardrails.title: Release train drift from unguarded Rust test modules
guardrails.bugClass: unguarded mod tests edits skipped by release-impact filtering
guardrails.why: rustProductionContent must only strip cfg(test)-gated test modules so edits inside an unguarded inline `mod tests` block remain package-impacting and force the required version bump instead of silently letting a tag mismatch through.

contains: Only cfg(test)-gated test modules are test-only
treats unguarded inline Rust test module edits as package-impacting
ignores cfg(test)-gated inline Rust test module edits

guardrails.title: A2A cancel canonical state guard
guardrails.bugClass: canceled tasks overwritten by later stores when status aliases are not canonicalized
guardrails.why: store_a2a_task_unless_canceled and a2a_canceled_task must canonicalize the status state before comparing so aliases like CANCELLED or STATE_CANCELED are respected and a canceled row is not overwritten.

guardrails.title: A2A compound secret redaction
guardrails.bugClass: compound credential metadata keys not redacted by exact-match-only secret detection
guardrails.why: a2a_ledger_metadata_key_is_secret must match suffix forms (webhookSecret, oauthToken, apiPassword) so compound credential fields are redacted, while preserving nonSecret/nonCredentials/notASecret exceptions and token-metric carve-outs.

guardrails.title: A2A history rich part refresh
guardrails.bugClass: non-text history parts dropped or stale text preserved during transcript-driven refresh
guardrails.why: a2a_merge_history_parts must preserve non-text parts (attachments, data payloads) while replacing all text-bearing parts (plain or decorated) with the refreshed transcript candidate so stale summary text does not survive.

guardrails.title: Learner transient quarantine parity
guardrails.bugClass: transient setup failures depressing durable routing confidence across record, load, and trim paths
guardrails.why: record_outcome, load, and trim must all exclude transient failures from pattern updates so get_label_success_rate and get_confidence_adjustment stay consistent with get_recommendations. Ambiguous transient phrases must be gated behind environment context.

guardrails.title: Learner promote repair consistency
guardrails.bugClass: same pattern qualifying for both promote and repair or using inconsistent stats
guardrails.why: get_recommendations must use pattern_non_transient_stats for both promote and repair decisions and exclude promoted patterns from repair candidates so a single pattern cannot appear in both lists.
